name: Business Book
tagline: Your LinkedIn network as a private BD pipeline you own
description: The BD pipeline tool built for how consultants actually work. Export your LinkedIn connections, drop the file in, and Business Book maps your whole network by firm, sector, seniority and function — surfaces who's gone cold and who to chase this week — and tracks every conversation through to a signed contract. Built-in AI (on your machine, or your own key) drafts your outreach, summarises meetings and briefs you before a call. Unlike a cloud CRM (Clay, Dex, Folk…), Business Book has no server of its own — your contacts and notes live in a file you hold, never uploaded to us; run the AI on your device and nothing leaves at all, or bring your own key and only what you ask about goes to the provider you chose, never through Freehold. Safe for the relationships you can't hand to someone else's cloud. Bought once, yours forever, no subscription.
